about.heading: About SITA
about.description:
SITA brings values into the everyday life of families. Through reflection, shared learning and practical guidance, we explore Sanskar, parenting, family wellbeing and personal and spiritual growth.

An initiative of Glory of Peace and Love (GOPAL Foundation), SITA welcomes individuals and families to learn together. Our programs are educational and do not replace professional medical or mental-health care.
